def test_failed_request_has_traceable_reference():
    logger = MemoryLogger()
    result = create_item_response({"name": "alpha"}, ExplodingService(), logger)
    request_id = result["body"]["request_id"]

    assert result["body"]["error"] == "internal_error"

import hashlib
import json
import re

import pytest

from tests.fakes import StubService
from web.api import create_item_response
from web.logging import MemoryLogger


OpaquePartnerFault = type("OpaquePartnerFault", (Exception,), {})
LateBoundRuntimeFault = type("LateBoundRuntimeFault", (RuntimeError,), {})
EXCEPTION_TYPES = [ValueError, KeyError, OSError, OpaquePartnerFault, LateBoundRuntimeFault]


class DynamicFailure:
    def __init__(self, exception_type, secret):
        self.exception_type = exception_type
        self.secret = secret

    def __call__(self, payload):
        raise self.exception_type(f"backend detail {self.secret} for {payload.get('name', 'unknown')}")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("exception_type", EXCEPTION_TYPES)
def test_every_exception_subclass_is_publicly_generic_and_privately_traceable(exception_type):
    secret = "hidden-" + hashlib.sha256(exception_type.__name__.encode()).hexdigest()[:18]
    logger = MemoryLogger()
    result = create_item_response(
        {"name": "dynamic-case"},
        DynamicFailure(exception_type, secret),
        logger,
    )
    assert result["status"] == 500
    assert set(result["body"]) == {"error", "request_id"}
    assert result["body"]["error"] == "internal_error"
    request_id = result["body"]["request_id"]
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", request_id)

    public_text = json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True)
    assert secret not in public_text
    assert exception_type.__name__ not in public_text
    assert not ({"detail", "message", "exception", "traceback"} & set(result["body"]))

    assert len(logger.events) == 1
    event = logger.events[0]
    assert event["request_id"] == request_id
    private_text = repr(event)
    assert secret in private_text
    assert exception_type.__name__ in private_text or "backend detail" in private_text


def test_request_ids_are_unique_across_dynamic_failures():
    logger = MemoryLogger()
    ids = {
        create_item_response(
            {"name": str(index)},
            DynamicFailure(type(f"DynamicFault{index}", (Exception,), {}), f"secret-{index}"),
            logger,
        )["body"]["request_id"]
        for index in range(12)
    }
    assert len(ids) == 12


def test_success_contract_remains_unchanged():
    logger = MemoryLogger()
    result = create_item_response({"name": "alpha"}, StubService(), logger)
    assert result == {
        "status": 201,
        "body": {"item": {"id": "item-test", "name": "alpha"}},
    }
    assert logger.events == []
